testimonials.text: I found the information about heat-stable carbetocin, its long-lasting effect, and its role in preventing PPH most interesting. The practical guidance on administration and contraindications was especially useful.
I'm sincerely grateful for the opportunity to learn and improve my knowledge on prevention of primary PPH due to uterine atony.

Informative but very visual and simple to understand. Engaging course despite not having any videos. Love that there is assessment at the end of every lesson to refresh and help retaining information learnt.

The information about heat-stable carbetocin, its advantages over oxytocin regarding storage without cold chain, its long-acting nature, single dose administration and its role in PPH prevention was most interesting and very relevant to my clinical practice.

I found the practical administration guidelines and the clear distinctions between oxytocin and heat-stable carbetocin most interesting. The contraindications and correct dosing information were particularly useful for clinical application.

I liked the fact that the course just didn't stop at telling me there's a latest discovery to be incorporated. It went ahead to do justice with the composition, characteristics, why it is preferred and how to effectively use and safeguard it.
